subject.title: /mcp show leaks raw MCP server credentials (env/headers) into group chats

question: Should this public MCP credential-disclosure report be repaired through the normal issue path now, or first routed through OpenClaw security handling before a fix is staged?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the item describes live credential exposure and already carries security-review/no-new-fix-pr labels, so automation should not choose the disclosure workflow on its own.

options.title: Security-handled repair first
options.body: Coordinate the narrow redaction/private-route fix through OpenClaw security handling, then land regression coverage once the disclosure path is accepted.

options.title: Normal issue repair
options.body: Keep the work public and land a focused fix that redacts `/mcp show` output and proves group replies no longer expose secrets.

recommendation.title: Security-handled repair first
recommendation.body: Coordinate the narrow redaction/private-route fix through OpenClaw security handling, then land regression coverage once the disclosure path is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent MCP config/security-adjacent history and current-line blame make this the best available owner for the security-handling choice.
